findings.citation: Solution §2: "The ADR takes the next free number in `docs/adr/` at merge time, not a number reserved now."
findings.note: main holds 0001-0005, so the next free number is 0006; 0006/0007 were treated as reserved by draft specs. Renumber and update Backend 13 and the epic's pointer.

findings.citation: Decisions taken: "The delivery files one `approval` item in `docs/inbox/`..."; walkthrough 15 [agent]
findings.note: No approval item for the layout exists yet.

findings.citation: Solution §1: Recommendation states the chosen layout, the cost in move features, any new dependency.
findings.note: The Recommendation says 7 features, 208/58 classes moved, global pieces at the root; the ADR says 8 features, 217/61, new shared/tenant/system packages. The human would approve from wrong numbers. People-group test count 6 vs 7.

findings.citation: Story 19: "the rule is true of the codebase at every point in the epic"; Decisions taken: "The amended text is true from the day it merges"
findings.note: The unmoved-cluster clause requires an entry in the boundary check's frozen list, which does not exist until package-boundary-check merges. Say it applies only once the check exists.

findings.citation: Non-goals: "The ADR maps each package to a glossary term rather than coining a new one."
findings.note: `shared` and `system` are coined and mapped to 'none'. Use glossary-based homes or record the exception as an explicit decision.

The frozen list grows by one entry per class added to an unmoved cluster, departing from the spec's 'a list that only shrinks'; flagged for the human's approval. Fixer: left as debt (deliberate, flagged in the ADR approval list).
The epic ticks package-layout-decision before the human approves the ADR, while the line says its spec ends in that approval.

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md: "It starts short and grows only when a recurring smell in `docs/tech-debt.md` earns promotion to a written rule; the loop proposes such promotions at epic closure, and the human decides."
findings.note: Backend 13 grows with new obligations to put into force ADR 0008, which is still proposed, with no 'Amended by the human' annotation. Resolved if the human's approval of ADR 0008 explicitly covers the Backend 13 amendment and the annotation is added.
Forward reference: the frozen exception list does not exist before package-boundary-check; 'After the move' is ambiguous (each cluster or the last).
Unmoved-cluster clause restated in both Backend 13 and ADR decision 6; precedence stated only for package-name examples.

findings.citation: Walkthrough 15 [agent]: "Show that the delivery's approval item exists in `docs/inbox/`"
Constraints: "Only files under `docs/` change. The allowed set is: this feature's folder; one new ADR file; the epic file; `docs/agents/coding-standards.md`."
findings.note: Commit 40ad852 edited two other features' draft specs, outside the allowed set, and left broken sentences. Reverted to main's version on the branch; the orchestrator redoes the ADR-number wording on main after delivery.
